traceability.notes:
Story docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md is fully implemented.
The require-test-traceability rule and its helpers provide: - A safe file-level @supports placeholder template with clear TODO-style guidance when missing, inserted at the top of test files (or just after a shebang) without touching implementation code (REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER, REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE). - Normalization of malformed [REQ-XXX] prefixes in it/test names for the exact shapes described in the story (spacing, underscores, parentheses, lowercase), but only when a REQ-based ID is already present and recognizable, never inventing new IDs and preserving overall formatting (REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT, REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE). - Configuration flags and behavior fully aligned with the story’s configuration section (`autoFixTestTemplate`, `autoFixTestPrefixFormat`, `testSupportsTemplate`). - Comprehensive tests that cover both template insertion and all specified malformed prefix forms, including the deliberate absence of auto-fix when there is no REQ prefix at all. - User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md that clearly explains the auto-fix capabilities, safety constraints, and configuration for test auto-fix behavior.
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements from the story are satisfied, and the relevant tests pass in the current test run, so the story status is PASSED.
